stories.title: Hotel to give away 1,500 items of furniture
stories.summary: A hotel in Liverpool is donating furniture from 216 rooms as it prepares for refurbishment.

stories.title: Four taken to hospital after chemical alert
stories.summary: Nineteen people suffered "mild irritation" after an unknown chemical caused a dust plume in Knowsley.

stories.title: Government could clean up huge illegal waste dump
stories.summary: The field near the M57 in Kirkby, Merseyside contains about 30,000 tonnes of heavy duty rubbish.

stories.title: Mayor says new Baltic station plan still stacks up
stories.summary: Steve Rotheram says the case for the Baltic Triangle station stacks up despite rising costs and delays.

stories.title: Ukrainian GCSE will help to 'preserve culture'
stories.summary: Families at a centre for Ukrainians in Warrington have welcomed the new qualification.

stories.title: Murder trial hears of King's Coronation claims
stories.summary: George Gordon allegedly sent messages to Delia McInerney's friends saying they attended the coronation.

stories.title: Crime drama is not portrayal of city I want to see, says mayor
stories.summary: Steve Rotheram says This City is Ours was "brilliant", but criticises its portrayal of Liverpool.

stories.title: Man proud to discover memorial for great-uncle killed in WW1
stories.summary: George Corfe had no idea about the tribute to his great uncle who worked at Garston gasworks.

stories.title: Tributes to 'devoted' dad and 'selfless' man killed in van crash
stories.summary: Two men died and two others were injured when a van crashed off a country lane in Goostrey.

stories.title: MPs voice opposition to Catholic schools academy plans
stories.summary: Eight MPs sign a letter to the Archbishop of Liverpool questioning the proposals.

stories.title: Cavern Club card signed 21 times by Beatles 'very unusual'
stories.summary: The signatures were collected by a fan in 1961 to send to her pen pal in New York.

stories.title: Boy, 14, held as police probe 'mindless vandalism'
stories.summary: About 20 youths in Huyton vandalised cars in an Asda car park and in a residential street, say police.
